data.narrative:
Singularity is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company seeking valuation following $82M in total capital raised. The valuation universe consists of 10 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including NODA AI, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI. The peer cohort spans $125M to $3.0B in valuation.

Two triangulation methods apply here. Stage-progression analysis anchors to Singularity's last post-money valuation of $400M and applies a typical 2.0x multiplier for Series A progression, implying $800M. Peer-median analysis draws from the 10-company comparable set, which exhibits a median valuation of $1.0B (range: $125M–$3.0B). The five named Series B peers—Dream Security at $3.0B, Allen Control Systems at $2.2B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Twenty at $1.0B—anchor the upper-end distribution.

The two methods triangulate to a valuation band of $680M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median estimate of $900M. This range reflects tension between stage-appropriate progression metrics and peer-set positioning. Key uncertainties include revenue traction relative to peer benchmarks, the sustainability of Defense & Security valuations in the current funding environment, and specification of Singularity's differentiated capability within a crowded frontier-tech cohort.
